{{Faction Infobox |title = Nethermancer |image = Nethermancer Jingran.jpg |leader = |base = |nation = Huanglong |region = Mengzhou }}{{Description|The Nethermancers are a mysterious, ancient order of explorers in Mengzhou.
They traverse all manner of Mirage Realms to cleanse threats and unearth relics from forgotten ruins, treading the edge between life and death.}} '''Nethermancers''' are a faction in [[Mengzhou]]. They are explorers who discover and cleanse [[Sonoro Sphere]]s (known as Mirage Realms in their circles) to prevent [[Tacet Discord]] outbreaks, and sell the ownerless relics they find inside. ==Members== ===Playable Nethermancers=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Playable Resonators&Nethermancer}} ===Former Members=== *[[Sandao]] ==Annals of Huanglong: Walking Between Yin and Yang — Nethermancer== Mortals are born to cross this world but once, from birth to death.
Yet Nethermancers tread the path between, moving through the shadows of yin and yang.
Mirage Realms, brimming with secrets, are lands where few dare to wander.
Even if you glimpse the ancient relics hidden within within, only the bold can claim them. Whispers say Nethermancers are doomed by their glimpses of fate—
Fated to grasp everything except fulfillment.

Those who choose this path become living vaults of uncanny talents, part seer, part ghost whisperer.
No lock or mechanism is too strange; they unravel mysteries with a mere flick of the wrist. Yet, few realize their true mission: to purge the Mirage Realms of lurking dangers.
If reverberations are left unchecked, Tacet Discords will fester and consume all.
Among them, one stands out, bearing a lamp of ghostly flame, delving deep to sever lingering threats.
Through his tales, the world learns of secrets long buried and the eerie denizens of the netherworld.

Should you ever find yourself lost in wonder, drawn by a glimmer of blue fire—
Follow its glow. It may be your only hope of survival. ==Gallery== File:Annals of Huanglong Nethermancer 01.jpg File:Annals of Huanglong Nethermancer 02.jpg File:Annals of Huanglong Nethermancer 03.jpg File:Item Qingfu Pendant.png|[[Qingfu Pendant]] ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Nethermancer |zhs = 寻幽客 |zht = 尋幽客 |ja = 尋幽客 |ko = 유람객 |fr = Mage de l'outre-monde |de = Unterweltwandler |es = Nigromante |th = ผู้ท่องปรภพ |pt = Inframante }} ==Navigation== {{Faction Navbox}} [[zh:寻幽客]]
